summary: Frontend-only test of ProfileVoice Phase 1 (Expo web preview, 390x844 + 320x640) with Playwright. Almost everything works: splash/role picker, dashboard counts (they match src/data/mock.ts for all 4 roles), summary-card navigation, quick actions, placeholder Back/Home, header buttons, role switching (chip sheet + More), the role-based More modules and Create menu, tab selected state, task/campaign filters, row details and toasts. One CRITICAL bug: tapping 'Exit demo mode' gives a blank screen with an endless 'Maximum update depth exceeded' error, because the splash and the tabs Home both use the route '/'. The same loop happens when you open or reload any tab route (/tasks, /campaigns, /more) without a role, so reloading only returns to the splash when you are on '/'. No deprecated Expo packages detected (no expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch). No react-native SafeAreaView misuse (react-native-safe-area-context insets are used).

ui_bugs.issue: Tapping it gives a blank white screen and an endless 'Maximum update depth exceeded' error. You never get back to the splash. Reproduced in a clean flow: Enter Demo -> tab-more -> exit-demo-button.

Opening or reloading /tasks, /campaigns or /more with no role (for example a page refresh while on those tabs) gives the same blank screen and 'Maximum update depth exceeded' loop instead of the splash. Opening /module/<key> with no role correctly redirects to the splash.

ui_bugs.component: create-menu / role-switcher routes without a role
ui_bugs.issue: Opening /create-menu with no role shows Super Admin create options (no role guard). Opening /role-switcher with no role also logs 'Maximum update depth exceeded' (its backdrop is the tabs '/' route).

issues: Summary card labels and hints are cut off with ellipsis: 'Active camp…', 'Pending appr…', 'Scheduled p…', 'Waiting on a deci…'. Let the label wrap to 2 lines or shorten it on small screens.
Module tile labels are cut off by numberOfLines=1: 'Schedule qu…' at 390px, and 'Content …' / 'Schedul…' at 320px. Allow 2 lines.
The absolutely positioned glow circle (right:-120) makes the document 440px wide, so the page can scroll sideways on web. Add overflow:'hidden' to the root.
Touch targets below 44pt: header-avatar-button is 38x38, active-role-chip is 32pt tall, and the 'See all'/'All tasks' links are 32pt tall (these have hitSlop=12, which is fine).
The role options have no accessibilityState (checked/selected), so screen readers cannot tell which role is picked.

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix the route clash at '/'. app/index.tsx (splash) and app/(tabs)/index.tsx (home) both resolve to '/'. Inside the tabs, router.replace('/') in app/(tabs)/more.tsx:30 and <Redirect href='/'> in app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx:47 resolve to (tabs)/index, so after exitDemo() the tabs layout keeps redirecting to itself forever. Recommended fix: give one of them a unique path, for example rename app/(tabs)/index.tsx to app/(tabs)/home.tsx (update Tabs.Screen/NativeTabs.Trigger name='home' and the router.replace('/(tabs)') / router.navigate calls), or move the splash to app/welcome.tsx and redirect to '/welcome'. Then retest exit-demo-button and a reload of /tasks.
Guard app/create-menu.tsx and app/role-switcher.tsx: when there is no role, redirect to the splash route.
Small screens: allow 2 lines for summary-card labels/hints and more-module labels.
Add overflow:'hidden' to the splash root View to stop sideways scrolling on web.
Raise header-avatar-button and active-role-chip to at least 44pt (size or hitSlop).
Add accessibilityState={{checked}} / accessibilityRole='radio' to the RoleList options.
critical_code_review_comments: app/(tabs)/more.tsx:29-32 leave(): calls router.replace('/') and then exitDemo(). With the duplicate '/' route this stays inside the tabs group, and the Redirect loop follows.
app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx:47 <Redirect href='/'> is ambiguous, because '/' is also the tabs' own index.
useActiveRole() quietly falls back to 'super_admin' when role is null (src/state/DemoContext.tsx:51). This hides guard bugs, for example create-menu showing Super Admin options with no role.
Good: all counts come from the services layer, role config is in one place, and testIDs are consistent.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (10 feature groups tested; exit-demo and the reload/deep-link guard fail)

Campaign filter chip testIDs are capitalised (filter-chip-All/Active/Scheduled/Draft/Completed); task chips are filter-chip-open/todo/progress/review/changes/ready/done. rca_of_issue: Repro: Enter Demo Mode -> More tab -> Exit demo mode, or reload the page on /tasks. Result: blank screen and repeated console error 'Maximum update depth exceeded'. RCA: Expo Router maps both app/index.tsx and app/(tabs)/index.tsx to '/'. From inside the (tabs) group, '/' resolves to (tabs)/index. When the role is null, TabsLayout renders <Redirect href='/'>, which lands on the same tabs layout, which redirects again, forever. /module/<key> is a root-level route, so its Redirect('/') correctly reaches the splash, which confirms the RCA. Mitigation: give the splash or the home tab a unique URL (see action_items).
